title: Residential Electricity Supply Billing Standard for Supply Lines
content:
Billing operations standard, Residential Electricity Supply. Beacon Ridge bills its supply charges on the utility's consolidated bill. Each utility billing cycle in which Beacon Ridge supplied the premise produces one energy charge line per time-of-use period and one monthly service fee line.

## When lines are billed

Supply charges are billed only while the agreement is active, drop pending or closed; no charge is ever billed on an agreement that never started supply (an agreement that is enrollment pending, rescinded or rejected). The agreement's status in the company's records is the basis for this test.

## Energy charge lines

- **Flat-rate plans.** The energy line carries the time-of-use period "all hours", and its amount is the kWh billed multiplied by the applicable rate in cents per kWh, divided by 100 and rounded half up to the cent.
- **Time-of-use plans.** The cycle's usage is split into an on-peak line and an off-peak line by the plan's off-peak window. On-peak kWh are billed at the contract rate; off-peak kWh are billed at the contract rate multiplied by the plan's off-peak rate multiplier. Each line's amount is its kWh multiplied by its rate in cents, divided by 100 and rounded half up to the cent.
- **Applicable rate, fixed plans.** The applicable rate of a fixed plan is the contract rate for every cycle of the term, changed only by a regulatory pass-through permitted under the regulatory pass-through terms.
- **Applicable rate, month-to-month plans.** The applicable rate of a month-to-month plan is set by the variable rate rules.

## Monthly service fee line

The fee line carries the period "all hours", 0 kWh, a rate of 0.00 and an amount equal to the plan's monthly service fee. It is billed in full for partial first and final cycles and is not billed when the fee is 0.00.

## Outside Beacon Ridge supply lines

Taxes and utility delivery charges are computed by the utility and are not Beacon Ridge supply lines.

## Worked lines (hypothetical figures)

| Line | kWh | Rate (cents per kWh) | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flat-rate energy, all hours | 812 | 11.37 | 812 multiplied by 11.37 is 9,232.44 cents, or 92.3244 USD, rounded to 92.32 USD |
| Time-of-use energy, on-peak | 540 | 12.10 | 65.34 USD |
| Time-of-use energy, off-peak, on Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 (multiplier 0.00) | 300 | 0.00 | 0.00 USD |
| Monthly service fee, partial first cycle | 0 | 0.00 | the full monthly service fee |

The supply charges billed on an agreement, net of its credits, form the agreement's billed supply balance: supply charges and early termination fees increase it; bill credits and rebill credits reduce it.
